summary.text: Western Australia won by 105 runs. WA 1st Innings made 406-5 d, Cameron Bancroft top-scoring with 186 off 341 balls; Brendan Doggett took 2 for 78. SAUS 1st Innings made 154-10, Jake Weatherald top-scoring with 40 off 30 balls; Jhye Richardson took 3 for 29. WA 2nd Innings made 169-10, Ashton Agar top-scoring with 48 off 101 balls; Brendan Doggett took 4 for 51. SAUS 2nd Innings made 316-10, Mackenzie Harvey top-scoring with 90 off 143 balls; Ashton Agar took 3 for 62.
